_readme: Har cheez yahan se badalti hai. Kisi bhi cheez ko chhedne ke liye code khholne ki zaroorat nahi. Tafseel: docs/SETTINGS.md

ratio._note: Final video ka hissa. Rhythm PATTERN se aata hai (stages/3-timeline.js). Niche mein koi avatar/host nahi (competitor channels bhi sab AI-image slideshow) — sirf images.

models._note: Har jagah LIST hai — pehla na chale to agla khud chal jata hai. 'or:' ka matlab OpenRouter. v4-pro abhi bahut khaali jawab de raha tha (har dusri call retry) — is liye v3.2 pehle rakha, v4-pro fallback mein (agla khud aazma leta hai agar v3.2 kabhi na chale).

claudeWrites._note: Ye teen cheezein DeepSeek nahi likhta — Claude likhta hai (behtar hook aur insani lehja). Dekho docs/GUIDE.md.

voice._note: PRODUCTION VOICE (2026-08-17 se): Kokoro (local), preset am_adam (American male). Chatterbox+Antoni pod-based cloning ka pace/clarity test fail ho gaya (~420wpm, 3x too fast, aur cloning quality bhi kharab) — jab tak wo theek na ho, Kokoro hi istemal hoga.

shot._note: Kitni der ek cheez screen par rahe. User ki hidayat (2026-08-17): 200-250 images per story — is liye har image ~17s tak rehti hai. Hook ke apne qaide hain (neeche). (koi avatar/stock is niche mein nahi, wo fields hata di gayin.)

hook._note: Video ke pehle 30 second — tez cuts.

sideBySide._note: Beech ki editing mein 2 images ek sath. randomCount = kitni dafa (poori video mein bikhri hui). 0 = band.

images._note: characterConsistency=false — koi avatar/reference photo nahi is niche mein, is liye Gemini CC-toggle ka purana (photo-lock) tareeqa band hai. Consistency ab DESCRIPTION se aati hai — stage 4 khud ek chhota character sheet banata hai (naam + physical description) aur har prompt usay follow karta hai.

captions._note: Word-highlight karaoke-style captions (competitor style) — jo lafz bol raha hai wahi highlightColor mein, baaki safed.

wordCount._note: Script ka sakht target — stages/1-script.js isi ke andar rehta hai (trim/extend dono).

particles._note: Halka floating dust/light-particle overlay (bilkul subtle) — user ki farmaish. Ek dafa cache hota hai (assets/particles_loop.mov), sab videos mein reuse.

render._note: Har tasveer par smooth motion — bari bari zoom-in, zoom-out, pan-left, pan-right. zoom = kitni shiddat (0.12 = halka). Ye 3x supersample + lanczos se banti hai (2026-08-17: 2x se 3x kiya, zyada smooth — pod ke cores is extra compute ko afford kar sakte hain) is liye SHAKE/jitter bilkul nahi.

concurrency._note: Ek sath kitne kaam. Purana/dheema laptop ho to kam kar do. render pod par RENDER_CONC env var se khud scale hoti hai (pod/entrypoint.sh) — ye value sirf local machine ke liye hai.
